specs.label: Transport ▸ rewind (|<)
specs.note: control-bar button 0 -> cmd.rewind(); echoes the equivalent command line

specs.label: Transport ▸ back (<)
specs.note: control-bar button 1 -> cmd.backward(); logs cmd.back()

specs.label: Transport ▸ stop ([])
specs.note: control-bar button 2 -> cmd.mstop() and also clears sculpting/rock

specs.label: Transport ▸ play/pause (>)
specs.note: control-bar button 3 -> cmd.mplay() when stopped (toggles to pause when playing)

specs.label: Transport ▸ play with Ctrl (rewind first)
specs.note: Ctrl+click should rewind then play; the audit driver cannot send a modifier with a click, so this drives a plain click and only asserts the play path does not crash. Ctrl-modified path is UNVERIFIED here.

specs.label: Transport ▸ forward (>)
specs.note: control-bar button 4 -> cmd.forward()

specs.label: Transport ▸ ending (>|)
specs.note: control-bar button 5 -> cmd.ending()

specs.label: Transport ▸ ending with Ctrl (middle)
specs.note: Ctrl+click should jump to the middle frame (cmd.middle()); the driver cannot send a modifier so this drives a plain click and only asserts no crash. Ctrl-modified path is UNVERIFIED here.

specs.label: Transport ▸ seq (sequence-viewer toggle)
specs.note: control-bar button 6 -> cmd.set('seq_view', ...)

specs.label: Transport ▸ rock toggle
specs.note: control-bar button 7 -> cmd.rock(1)/cmd.rock(0)

specs.label: Transport ▸ full (full screen)
specs.note: control-bar button 8 -> browser Fullscreen API; logs cmd.full_screen(). requestFullscreen may reject in headless (swallowed).

specs.label: Frame scrollbar (range input)
specs.note: the frame range is disabled until a movie exists; setup defines one via mset then seeks -> cmd.set_frame(v, 7)

specs.label: Tab ▸ edit

specs.note: selects the Movie menu tab (ported _gui.py tree)

specs.note: selects the rock/spin/nutate + camera tab

specs.label: Timeline ▸ left-click a frame (seek)
specs.note: left-click/drag on the canvas seeks (cmd.set_frame v,7). The canvas rows come from get_movie_panel(), which is a bridge-only endpoint; in local mode nframes=0 and every pointer handler early-returns, so this cannot be driven locally.

specs.label: Timeline ▸ wheel (+/- one frame)
specs.note: wheel over the canvas steps a frame (cmd.forward/backward). Needs get_movie_panel frames>0 (bridge only).

specs.label: Timeline ▸ right-drag (mmove)
specs.note: right-drag emits cmd.mmove(target,source,count,object). Free canvas drag on a bridge-only panel; not drivable locally.

specs.label: Timeline ▸ shift+right-drag (mcopy)
specs.note: shift+right-drag emits cmd.mcopy(...). Bridge-only panel + modifier drag; not drivable locally.

specs.label: Timeline ▸ ctrl+left-drag right (minsert)
specs.note: ctrl+left-drag inserts blank frames (cmd.minsert). Bridge-only panel + modifier drag; not drivable locally.

specs.label: Timeline ▸ ctrl+left-drag left (mdelete)
specs.note: ctrl+left-drag the other way deletes frames (cmd.mdelete). Bridge-only panel + modifier drag; not drivable locally.

specs.label: Timeline ▸ ctrl+middle-drag (mview clear)
specs.note: ctrl+middle-drag clears keyframes in a span (cmd.mview clear first/last). Bridge-only panel + middle-button drag; not drivable locally.

specs.label: Timeline ▸ ctrl+shift-drag (all rows / column mode)
specs.note: ctrl+shift drag applies to every row (column mode). Bridge-only panel + modifier drag; not drivable locally.

specs.label: Timeline ▸ ctrl+shift wheel (row height)
specs.note: ctrl+shift wheel writes movie_panel_row_height. Bridge-only panel + modifier wheel; not drivable locally.

specs.label: Timeline ▸ right-click (Camera/Object Motion menu)
specs.note: a right-click with <5px travel opens the Camera/Object Motion context menu (MotionMenu: store/store-with-scene/store-with-state/clear/interpolate/smooth/...). Needs get_movie_panel frames>0 (bridge only), so the whole MotionMenu tree is unreachable in local mode.

specs.label: Export ▸ close
specs.note: closes the export dialog

specs.label: Export ▸ width input
specs.note: output width; value feeds the export, not visible body text, so only no-crash is observable in local (png) mode

specs.label: Export ▸ height input
specs.note: output height; value feeds the export, not visible body text

specs.label: Export ▸ 720p preset
specs.note: sets size to a <=16:9 720p box; effect is on the numeric inputs (not body text)

specs.label: Export ▸ 480p preset
specs.note: sets size to a <=16:9 480p box

specs.label: Export ▸ 360p preset
specs.note: sets size to a <=16:9 360p box

specs.label: Export ▸ format png
specs.note: png radio — the only format enabled without an encoder probe (bridge)

specs.label: Export ▸ format mp4
specs.note: mp4 radio is disabled until get_movie_encoders() (bridge) reports ffmpeg/convert; disabled in local mode

specs.label: Export ▸ format webm
specs.note: webm radio is disabled until the encoder probe (bridge) reports ffmpeg/convert

specs.label: Export ▸ format mpg
specs.note: mpg radio is disabled until the encoder probe (bridge) reports mpeg_encode

specs.label: Export ▸ format mov
specs.note: mov radio is disabled until the encoder probe (bridge) reports ffmpeg/convert

specs.label: Export ▸ format gif
specs.note: gif radio is disabled until the encoder probe (bridge) reports ffmpeg/convert

specs.label: Export ▸ quality input
specs.note: quality spinbox is disabled for png and for the convert encoder; only reachable once an encoded format is selected (needs the bridge encoder probe)

specs.label: Export ▸ ray checkbox
specs.note: toggles ray-tracing of each exported frame; checkbox state only (no body-text change)

specs.label: Export ▸ output prefix input
specs.note: output path prefix; value feeds the export filename, not visible body text

specs.label: Export ▸ export (run)
specs.note: runs cmd.movie_export_png / cmd.movie_produce; both are bridge-only endpoints. In local mode the source reports 'export endpoint unavailable', so real export requires the bridge.
